whatIs: Neobrutalism components is a collection of 64 neobrutalist-style components, with thick borders, hard shadows and bold colors, for React and Tailwind v4. It builds on shadcn/ui and Base UI and includes charts and star shapes.
It's a good fit when you want an interface with a strong personality, or want to learn the style, without drawing each piece.
uses: Giving a portfolio or a personal landing page a striking visual identity.
Building forms, cards and buttons with a consistent neobrutalist style.
Showing data with charts in the same style on a small dashboard.
caveats: It requires Tailwind v4, so check your project's version.
The style is very distinctive and doesn't suit every product, especially more sober ones.
Since it's based on shadcn/ui, it helps to be familiar with that workflow of copying components into your project.
pricingNote: Open source under the MIT license; there's no paid plan.
idealFor: Tailwind projects that want a neobrutalist look.
